description: This file defines the class Smarty_Internal_Method_SetAutoloadFilters, which manages the setting of autoload filters in the Smarty templating system. It includes methods to set filters and validate filter types, handling different filter types such as 'pre', 'post', 'output', and 'variable'.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Method_SetAutoloadFilters
classes.description: Handles setting autoload filters for Smarty templates, including validation of filter types.

methods.name: setAutoloadFilters
methods.description: Sets autoload filters for the Smarty object, either for a specific filter type or for all filters.

methods.name: _checkFilterType
methods.description: Validates if a filter type is among the allowed types; throws an exception if invalid.
